title: WHO Medical Product Alert N°6/2022: Substandard (contaminated) paediatric medicines identified in WHO region of Africa
reviewedBy: Claude Code, transcribed from the WHO alert PDF; pending review by Pranshu Rastogi

notes: Identified in The Gambia and reported to WHO in September 2022. WHO: "All batches of these products should be considered unsafe until they can be analyzed by the relevant National Regulatory Authorities." The alert title calls them paediatric medicines.
